I farm this wheat plot like I did last year. I have some schooling so I know DAP and urea help the wheat fill out, and the cooperative brings fertilizer most seasons even if it comes late. My husband and I own this land, so I am willing to put manure from our oxen on it, but cash is tight and I will not buy more than one bag of DAP and one bag of urea for this plot. I use the wheat seed I saved from last harvest — improved seed is expensive and the agro-dealer is far, so I stick with what I know works on this soil.
